description: This file defines color-related constants, types, and utility functions for managing color palettes, shades, and color picking in a project. It imports external color data from 'open-color' and exports various color configurations and helper functions.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects specific keys from a source object and returns a new object with those key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSpecificColorShades
methods.description: Returns specific shades of a given color from the open-color palette based on provided indexes.

methods.name: getAllColorsSpecificShade
methods.description: Returns an array of specific shades across multiple colors, excluding gray, transparent, and black.

methods.name: rgbToHex
methods.description: Converts RGB color values to a hexadecimal color string.
